name: Barbara Sakan
source:
Barbara Sakan is the youngest member of the family. Her mother died a long time ago, and her father has been travelling the world ever since, so she has always been close with her brother, who is 7 years older than her. Barbara is about to turn 17 and is beginning to enter the social circles, but she isn't looking forward to it. She'd rather stay free to attack Sulla with her brother. Up until now, Barbara has chased away six suitors with her archery skills taught by her brother. Her marriage has become a big concern within the Sakan family.

[From [url=https://helix-waltz.fandom.com/wiki/Barbara_Sakan]Helix Waltz Wiki[/url]]
